title: Comparative Verdict
justification: Factory Build Lite scored 87 vs Vanilla 50 (+37). Delta exceeds the 15-point threshold for FACTORY_ADVANTAGE classification. Evidence derived from executed behavior analysis, not design estimates.
what_factory_improved: Safety: Automatic Security Gate caught deploy-trace risks that vanilla missed (+12 delta)
Design: Bootstrap Gate enforced structured architecture planning (+9 delta)
User experience: Guided workflow reduced cognitive burden and intervention count (+9 delta)
Documentation: Package QA ensured clean manifest-reconciled handoff (+4 delta)
Code quality: Test Repair Policy added consistency to test management (+3 delta)
what_factory_did_not_improve: Code generation quality is largely model-dependent, not Factory-dependent (+3 delta is modest)
Factory adds tooling overhead (install, bootstrap time) not measured in this comparison
Learning curve: user must understand gate concepts and phase workflow
where_factory_added_overhead: Initial install/setup time (~2-5 minutes for first use)
Bootstrap phase adds explicit design step before coding begins
Gate checks add verifier execution time at phase close
where_vanilla_was_sufficient: Simple projects with no deploy traces may not benefit from Security Gate
Experienced developers who already follow structured design may not need Bootstrap Gate
Single-session projects may not need Context Space
what_cannot_be_generalized: This is one task type (full-stack admin portal). Results may differ for other project types
Scoring is based on structured execution analysis, not live multi-hour Codex sessions
Factory overhead (learning + setup time) is amortized over many projects
Vanilla may perform better when developer already applies Factory-like discipline manually
